info.brief: Functionality to work with Play Asset Delivery and the AssetPackManager
info.description: Functionality to work with Play Asset Delivery and the AssetPackManager

elements.name: pad.cancel
elements.description: Requests to cancel the download of the specified asset packs.

elements.name: pad.fetch
elements.description: Requests to download the specified asset pack.

elements.name: pad.remove_pack
elements.description: Deletes the specified asset pack from the internal storage of the app.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_state
elements.description: Requests download state and details for the specified asset pack. This is an asynchronous function and will send a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event once the new state is available.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_location
elements.description: Returns the location of the specified asset pack on the device or an empty string if this pack is not downloaded.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_bytes_downloaded
elements.description: Returns the total number of bytes already downloaded for the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_error_code
elements.description: Returns the error code for the pack, if Play has failed to download the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_status
elements.description: Returns the download status of the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_total_bytes_to_download
elements.description: Returns the total size of the pack in bytes. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_transfer_progress_percentage
elements.description: Returns the percentage of the asset pack already transferred to the app. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.show_confirmation_dialog
elements.description: Shows a dialog that asks the user for consent to download packs Shows a dialog that asks the user for consent to download packs that are currently in either the AssetPackStatus.REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION state or the AssetPackStatus.WAITING_FOR_WIFI state. Will return result in event listener.
